profile_text.body:
Meta's developer site presents the company as a provider of AI models and tools for developers, offering access to Muse Spark through Muse Code and the Meta Model API. The company describes Muse Spark as tuned for long-horizon coding workflows, with fewer unnecessary turns and cleaner output, and says it performs competitively with frontier models across several coding evals. It says a first working request takes under five minutes and that an existing OpenAI SDK compatible client can be pointed at the Meta Model API, and it offers a search grounding tool that gives a model live access to the web. Muse Image is available on the Meta Model API at $0.01/image, described as a reasoning model that plans layout before drawing, with anchored composition for consistent edits. The product tracked for Meta is Llama, an open-weight model family that is often self-hosted.

Meta is a public company, ticker META, founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, CA, USA, with CIK 0001326801. Its most recent revenue filing is a 10-K for the period ending 2025-12-31, reporting $200,966,000,000.

Three lawsuits are recorded: Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the District Court, W.D. Texas; Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the District Court, N.D. California; and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the U.S. District Court, N.D. California. California accounts for 281 of the cases counted. MCP servers listed in connection with Meta include Meta Ads automation servers such as ai.adweave/meta-ads-mcp, which is described as having 47 tools for campaigns, creatives, audiences and insights, co.pipeboard/meta-ads-mcp and com.adbloop/meta-ads, along with ai.fastmetal/fastmetal, ai.livingmeta/ai-in-research, ai.primeta/primeta and app.metadock/metadock.
